_about.authoredOrGenerated: AUTHORED. The source of truth for every color/typography/dimension value. Three tiers: tier 1 primitives (raw scale values), tier 2 semantic (meaning: color/text, color/link), tier 3 component (badge/font-size — each claimed by exactly ONE contract).
_about.compiledBy: scripts/build-tokens.mjs — one pass emits BOTH src/scss/abstracts/_tokens-generated.scss (with the @media breakpoint switching) AND claude-design/tokens.css. Never hand-edit either output; `--check` gates both. scripts/build-catalog.mjs then compiles the alias-resolved inventory agents actually read (see docs/examples/catalog.example.json).
_about.format: Style Dictionary-style { value, comment } leaves with {dot.path} alias references — NOT the DTCG $value dialect. Plus three local extensions documented below: brandChannel, reserved breakpoint leaves, and the 0 sentinel.

audiences.builder agent / human: the only audiences that EDIT these files. Consumer agents never read tokens/ — they read catalog/tokens.lean.json, where the alias chains are already resolved.
audiences.checkers: build-tokens.mjs validates at compile time (unresolvable refs, brandChannel mismatches are hard errors); check-figma.mjs compares compiled values per mode against the committed Figma snapshot.

_about.editWarning: Changing a token VALUE or alias is a Figma-coupled change: it enters check-figma's staleness hash, so the Figma variable must be updated and figma/snapshot.json re-captured + --stamped before check:drift passes. Changing only a comment is free.
moreInfo: tokens/README.md — naming grammar, tier rules, provenance conventions
contracts/README.md — pipeline step 2 (authoring tier-3 tokens during a migration)
https://styledictionary.com/ — the format this dialect descends from
https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/15339657135383 — Figma variables, the other view of these values

value.purpose: The token's value: a literal ('0', '.75em', '#BD472A') or an alias reference in {dot.path} form ('{typography.font-size.25}', '{color.status.danger}').
value.notes: Prefer aliases to primitives over re-stating literals — the alias chain IS the provenance. Bare em resolves against the OWNING COMPONENT's font-size, not the root; rem is always root.

comment.purpose: Provenance: the SCSS file:line it was read from, what Sass variable it compiled from, rulings that changed it, and traps (e.g. two primitives sharing a hex value — pick by SOURCE FAMILY, not by number).
comment.audience: builder agents and humans. Flows into catalog/tokens.json ('note') but is DROPPED from tokens.lean.json, so it costs consumers nothing.
comment.consumedBy: no checker reads its content — editing a comment stales catalog/ (regenerate it) but never Figma.

brandChannel.purpose: LOCAL EXTENSION. Marks a token as riding a theme channel: it compiles to var(--brand-primary)/var(--brand-secondary) instead of its alias chain, so grayscale/alternate themes retune it. build-tokens.mjs hard-errors if the token's alias does not resolve to the channel's default value.
brandChannel.rule: Provenance survives a value swap: channel stays channel, literal stays flat. Badge's primary/color is a flat #000 while Button's is brandChannel secondary — identical render today, different provenance; do not 'unify' them.

breakpointLeaves.purpose: LOCAL EXTENSION. A token whose leaf keys are mobile / md / page switches per breakpoint: build-tokens.mjs emits :root plus @media (min-width: 980px / 1350px) overrides.
breakpointLeaves.warning: mobile/md/page are RESERVED leaf names. A component that switches OUTSIDE that grid (e.g. banner at 768, card at 400) must carry the breakpoint in the token NAME instead (name/base, name/sm) — otherwise the generator crashes or silently moves the switch to 980.

zeroSentinel.purpose: LOCAL EXTENSION. A dimension value of 0 means auto/content-driven, not zero pixels. Figma variants must not bind these (rule respect-breakpoint-modes).

naming.purpose: Path IS the name: tokens/components/badge.json's badge.padding.inline becomes token 'badge/padding/inline', Figma variable 'badge/padding/inline', and CSS custom property '--uiowa-badge-padding-inline' (WEB codeSyntax). One grammar, four views.
naming.notes: Primitive scale steps ($xsm…$xxxlg, font/size/25…) are shared vocabulary — PRIMITIVES, never tier-3, even when only one component uses them today.

font-size.comment: badge.scss:8. CHANGED 2026-08-20 from a raw 75% to an absolute rem primitive per the design system owner's ruling — a DELIBERATE DESIGN CHANGE, not a fidelity bug; do not restore the percentage.

inline.comment: badge.scss:6 — em kept deliberately: tracks the badge's OWN font-size, which is now absolute, so this is a fixed 9px expressed proportionally.

background.comment: badge.scss:16 — background: variables.$primary, which compiles to var(--brand-primary).

_breakpointExample._note: REAL, copied verbatim from tokens/components/brand-bar.json on 2026-08-22. An earlier draft of this file invented an `iowa-bar` group with mobile: 50px — wrong twice: there is no iowa-bar token group (iowa-bar is the CSS class; the token root is `brand-bar`), and the mobile value is the 0 sentinel, not 50px. 50px belongs to brand-bar/min-height/narrow, and even there it is the md/page value. Copy from the repo, never from memory — this is the one example an agent authoring a breakpoint token would clone.
